scripts.dist:bundle: yarn dump:meta && cd .. && tsup --config tsup.pkg.ts && yarn --cwd tools dist:css && node ./tools/release/annotate-props-jsdoc.js && node ./tools/release/annotate-components-jsdoc.js && node ./tools/release/annotate-slots-jsdoc.js && node ./tools/release/generate-package-json.js && node ./tools/release/generate-readme.js
